response.overview: After Mira's death, Mikael is still unable to accept the reality and cannot let go of his love for his wife. A year later, he meets Maira, who is Mira's twin and has a similar face but with a different appearance and personality. He tries to change Maira's appearance and personality according to his taste. However, Maira wants to be loved for who she is, not because of her face.
response.title: Kembar Kasih
